title: Minimizing 0-currents supported in the constraint set vanish
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, let A ⊆ ℝ^P be an arbitrary set and let T ∈ 𝒟_0(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U 0). If T is minimizing in A (IsMinimizingIn T A, Simon 7.1.1; in degree 0 the condition ∂S = ∂T is vacuous, SameBoundary = True) and spt T ⊆ A, then T = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U A : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U 0), IsOpen U → IsMinimizingIn T A → T.support ⊆ A → T = 0
